scope: Learn sensor likelihoods from labeled calibration evidence; state vocabulary, transitions, costs, and initial state prior remain known.
acquisition_gate: Learned adaptive multiclass Brier has a negative upper paired 95% episode-bootstrap bound against learned fixed probe_a, probe_b, probe_c and random, at equal acquisition caps and shared calibration cost.
numerical_gate: Minimum effective particle count across adaptive and fixed/random learned runs must be at least 10% of the particle bank; otherwise report the inference approximation as unresolved.
scores: Multiclass Brier is sum over states of squared probability errors (range 0..2); log loss is minus log probability of the realized state. No clipping.
uncertainty: Independent Beta calibration posteriors. Fixed parameter particles are weighted jointly with hidden states by acquired evidence; no resampling. Particle ESS and draw digest are recorded. Credible intervals describe calibration posteriors, not runtime state probabilities.
restrictions: No holdout tuning. Prior binary benchmark splits remain unchanged. Evaluation labels and true sensor likelihoods never enter the learner process. Oracle is an evaluator-only reference on the adaptive acquired readings. No automatic production model promotion.
